parsed.rationale: Both `HLSAVPlayerProtocol` (in `Shared/Playback/Sources/HLSPlayer/Protocol/HLSAVPlayerProtocol.swift`) and `PlayerProtocol` (in `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Protocols/RadioPlayerProtocol.swift`) live in the same `Playback` package and share three identical members: `pause:()`, `play:()`, and `rate:Float`. `HLSAVPlayerProtocol` is a strict superset of `PlayerProtocol`, adding HLS-specific capabilities (`currentTime`, `seek`, `seekableTimeRanges`). The idiomatic Swift approach is to make `HLSAVPlayerProtocol` inherit from `PlayerProtocol`, eliminating the three redundant declarations in the child and establishing a clear capability hierarchy. Neither record carries any test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flags, so this is production protocol surface eligible for consolidation.
